name: The Mac's phone tools' state on the phone
purpose: what tools/phone keeps on the phone between runs: the touch monitor tools/phone/idle.sh starts (powos-touchmon.sh: the last touch-panel IRQ change every 2 s -> powos-lasttouch, so the Mac knows if the user is active; it exits 30 min after the last ask) and the verify runner's heartbeat (powos-verify-runner, the AI page's VerifyRun state)
unbounded: one sh loop (awk on /proc/interrupts + sleep 2), self-ending after 30 min without an ask
